import base64, textwrap
script = r'''
import csv
import pathlib
import re
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

zip_path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
if not zip_path.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f\"Input zip not found: {zip_path}\")

num_re = re.compile(r\""'^[+-]?(?:'"\\d+(?:\\.\\d*)?|\\.\\d+)(?:[eE][+-]?\\d+)?%?"'$")

def parse_phykit_output(stdout):
    for line in reversed([ln.strip() for ln in stdout.splitlines() if ln.strip()]):
        parts = re.split(r"'"\\s+\", line)
        numeric = [p.rstrip('%') for p in parts if num_re.match(p)]
        if len(numeric) >= 3:
            return int(float(numeric[-3])), int(float(numeric[-2])), float(numeric[-1])
    raise ValueError(f\"Could not parse PhyKit output: {stdout"'!r}")

def run_pis(path):
    attempts = [
        ["phykit", "pis", str(path)],
        ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", str(path)],
        ["phykit", "parsimony-informative-sites", str(path)],
    ]
    failures = []
    for cmd in attempts:
        completed = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True)
        if completed.returncode == 0 and completed.stdout.strip():
            return parse_phykit_output(completed.stdout)
        failures.append(" ".join(cmd) + f" => rc={completed.returncode}; stderr={completed.stderr.strip()!r}; stdout={completed.stdout.strip()!r}")
    raise RuntimeError("All PhyKit PIS command attempts failed:'"\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(failures))

rows = []
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
    members = sorted(
        name for name in zf.namelist()
        if not name.endswith(\"/\") and name.endswith(\".faa.mafft\")
    )
    if not members:
        raise SystemExit(\"No .faa.mafft alignment members found in archive\")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        tmpdir = pathlib.Path(tmp)
        for idx, member in enumerate(members):
            out_path = tmpdir / f\"alignment_{idx}.faa.mafft\"
            with zf.open(member) as src, out_path.open(\"wb\") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
            pis_count, total_sites, percentage = run_pis(out_path)
            rows.append((member, pis_count, total_sites, percentage))

percentages = [row[3] for row in rows]
median_percentage = statistics.median(percentages)

with open(\"per_alignment_pis.tsv\", \"w\", newline=\"\") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter=\"\\t\")
    writer.writerow([\"alignment\", \"parsimony_informative_sites\", \"total_sites\", \"percentage\"])
    writer.writerows(rows)

with open(\"median_percentage.txt\", \"w\") as handle:
    handle.write(format(median_percentage, \".12g\") + \"\\n\")

with open(\"run_summary.tsv\", \"w\", newline=\"\") as handle:
    writer = csv.writer(handle, delimiter=\"\\t\")
    writer.writerow([\"selected_alignment_count\", \"median_percentage\"])
    writer.writerow([len(rows), format(median_percentage, \".12g\")])
'''.strip() + '\\n'
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"
